Package com.mimecast.robin.mime

Class HeaderFraming

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.mime.HeaderFraming
public final class HeaderFraming extends Object
Constant-state validation of raw header line endings and controls, without rewriting bytes. Validation stops at the first empty LF or CRLF line; body bytes are opaque.
